4. //     inner.bitmap.number_of_bits() - inner.bitmap.usage()

7. // The key to faithfulness is the MODULE BOUNDARY: the real `::bitmap::Bitmap`
8. // has a `closed spec fn view` defined in a *different crate*, so
9. // `inner.bitmap@.num_bits` is OPAQUE in `frame.rs` — its `>= 0` lower bound is
10. // not visible. Here `Bitmap` lives in an inner `mod bm` and is called from
11. // outside, so its closed view is likewise hidden (closed-spec bodies are visible
12. // only within their defining module). A same-module model would leak

62.

65.         closed spec fn view(&self) -> BitmapView {

67.         }
68.     }

73.         }

77.         pub fn number_of_bits(&self) -> (result: u32)
